items.subject: Compare per-step and persistent OpenMP teams
items.objective: Replace the serial sweeps with OpenMP work over disjoint rows or slabs, honoring the threads argument as a CPU budget. Compare a team created for each timestep with a persistent team spanning all six steps, measuring any fork/join savings against synchronization and buffer-parity handling. Ensure workers finish each timestep before the next reads its output. Preserve full initialization, update bounds, and boundaries. Test correctness and native wall time at one and four cores, including initialization and overhead.
